case_name: Suchand Pal v Phani Pal and Another
respondent:
Phani Pal and Another
Supreme Court of India

6 November 2003
Appeal (Crl.) 176 of 1997
The Judgment was delivered by : Arijit Pasayat, J.
1.  This appeal has been filed questioning correctness of the judgment rendered by a Division Bench of the Calcutta High Court directing acquittal of the respondent No. 1 (hereinafter referred to as the 'accused'). The Additional Sessions Judge, 3rd Court, Midnapore, had found the accused guilty of offence punishable under Sections 302 and 307 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (For short the "IPC") and also Section 25 of the Arms Act, 1959 (for short the "Arms Act").
2. Sentence of imprisonment for life, 7 years and one year respectively was awarded.

holding: The appeal fails and is dismissed.
